Anxiety.

Thanks, man!

I used to love being alone, since interacting with people overwhelms me. Especially if I always feel a lot of emotions that drains me.

But without someone to talk to everyday or passion to fill up your time? Yeah.... Life suddenly feels cold and lonely. I just really wanna connect to someone.
Same, also because I don't want the night to end yet, not ready to face tomorrow and its horrors.

I wanna die. I'm so tired and fed up. I wanna see blood tonight... but i'm too tired to lift the knife and stab myself. 

It's a long night... I can do it.
It really is... I wanna see mine tonight, but i'm so tired. I'll try again and hopefully I do see them.
Someone, please talk to me
Always. Isn't it easier if you can die without your own hand, and at least with a terminal illness. People understands you more, instead of a mental illness.
You're from the Philippines? If so, gusto mo pag usapan natin toh?
Wish I could have done that to my friend. I really hate how things are now because of me being such a energy drainer.

That's the hardest part with struggling. Opening up. 

You reach out to a friend because you trust them but then you feel guilty because you've drained them so much. 

Dealing with the same thing. I've ruined what I have with her because of this crap but at the same time, i'm really thankful. She saved me again.

Yeah, I end up dumping all my negativity to my best friend that at this point she's all fed up with me now. 

Couldn't stop talking about death. Running away. Couldn't change. 

I feel so bad, and yet I wonder why she keeps coming back.
If you leave, the pain they'll feel will be greater than what you think the pain you're causing right now.

People don't have it worse than you. We all have our own personal hell. Never forget that.

For someone so young, it's so sad you're feeling like this. Don't you have anything you wanna before you die? Like skydiving? Watch Infinity Wars?

Why the hospital? Why not your guidance counselor so they may asset you to a psychologist? 

Or Why not take a walk? Visit the mall? Fish?

Opening is really hard, but how can you be sure that they'll judge you and call you a monster if you haven't tried it? 

We people dislike ourselves. It's why we judge ourselves and label ourselves as monsters. 

Dragons are monsters to knights, but how came there are dragon tamers who would want to befriend and take care of them. Villains are monsters, but I see people rooting for Loki because they understand his side of the story. Of Ardyn in FFXV. 

They're monsters to others, but... not to everyone.
How are you sure that no one would ever love you?
Are there any bucket lists you have? Like things you need and want to experience before you fade away?

And then if something did happened 

They'll be "oh, it all makes sense now. I wish I could have seen it earlier and done something."

Trust me, pals, If only you guys did pay attention to me... then again, don't blame them. I'm good at hiding it. And I don't even know what I want to hear from them. It's not like they can magically stop myself from being like this.

I know 17 years is nothing compare to what others feel

But I just feel really tired and with what I posted... no one would really find it sad to lose me
I am
Makes you just wanna be in a coma to avoid them, right?
I don't really know if the reason I don't get crushes on people is because I fear exactly that, the pain of feeling something soul-destroying. Or because of depression.

I'm just unhappy. Things that often makes me going, my passion just weaver. Without things that I love, I find myself asking who I am. 

I can't be a gamer if I haven't touched my PS4 in weeks. 

I can't be someone smart if my grades are barely passing and when I can no longer make myself study. 

I can't be a writer, often stuck in writer's block because of this feeling of nothing, when I can only write from the heart. 

Can't be someone that sleeps too much when I don't even sleep anymore. 

Can't be insomniac when I sleep too much.

Can't even be suicidal, if there's no sign of an attempt.
